title: CI Observe — Why runs fail
description: Why E2E runs fail: causes, steps, failing and flaky tests, errors and every failed run.

options.content: **Why E2E runs fail.** A run's cause is the phase of its **first failed step**: *Tests* (a test failed), *Build* or *OSAC install* (the code under test), *CI infrastructure* (cluster, hosts, CI setup, teardown, a timeout, a lost runner) or *Blocked* (an unapproved fork or refused inputs). The failing and flaky tests and their errors come from the JUnit reports.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs GitHub marked failed or timed out. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Failure rate
panels.description: Failed ÷ (passed + failed). Population: passed and failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs; cancelled runs are left out. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: Tests failed
panels.description: Failed in a test step. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Build failed
panels.description: Failed building the code under test. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: OSAC install failed
panels.description: Failed installing OSAC or its operators. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: CI infrastructure
panels.description: Failed in cluster or host setup, CI setup, logs or teardown, timed out, or lost its runner. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Blocked
panels.description: An unapproved fork pull request, or inputs the workflow refused. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Cancelled
panels.description: Not failures: runs cancelled, usually because a newer push replaced them. Population: finished VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (passed, failed or cancelled). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Failed runs per day, by area
panels.description: Each bar is one day's failed runs, split by the area of their cause. The Causes table splits CI infrastructure further. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: one point per UTC day the runs were created, last $days days. Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Causes
panels.description: Failed runs per cause, their share and the change in count. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above); 'vs before' compares with the $days days before. Unit: count of runs and percent.

panels.title: Failures by suite
panels.description: Failed runs of each suite, split by the area of their cause. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Steps that failed
panels.description: The step each failed run stopped in, the most frequent first. 'Last failed' opens the newest such run. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs and percent.

panels.title: Tests that fail
panels.description: Every test that failed, the most failures first. Flaky commits: commits on which the test both passed and failed, a sign of flakiness rather than a regression. Click a test for its history. Population: test results in the JUnit reports of the suite runs; a skipped test is not a run. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above); 'vs before' compares with the $days days before. Unit: count of runs, percent and duration.

panels.title: Flaky tests
panels.description: Tests that passed and failed on the same commit, the most flaky commits first. Population: test results in the JUnit reports of the suite runs; a skipped test is not a run. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of commits and runs.

defaults.noValue: No test passed and failed on the same commit

panels.title: Error messages
panels.description: The failure messages in the JUnit reports, grouped after replacing names, ids and numbers. Tests: how many different tests failed with it. Population: test results in the JUnit reports of the suite runs; a skipped test is not a run. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of failures.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Every failed run, newest first: its cause, the step it stopped in and, when tests failed, the first failed test and its error. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: time, count and duration as named.

value.title: Open the run (GitHub when it was not recorded)

panels.title: About these numbers
panels.description: What this page counts, over which window, what is missing or partial, and when each source was last written, as the API computed it. Population: the page's own population, named in the first column. Time: the window in the second column. Unit: text.
